title: Uniform bounds and Lipschitz control for fixed-support Fourier integrals
statement: Over $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field], let $m\geq1$, let $K\subset\mathbf R^m$ be compact, and let $u:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf C$ be Lebesgue measurable, zero almost everywhere off $K$, with $\|u\|_2^2=\int|u|^2<\infty$. Write $v=\operatorname{vol}(K)$ and $b=(\int_K|x|^2\,dx)^{1/2}$; both are finite. Then $u\in L^1$, and its absolutely convergent Fourier integral $h(\xi)=\int e^{-2\pi i x\cdot\xi}u(x)\,dx$ satisfies $$|h(\xi)|\leq v^{1/2}\|u\|_2,\qquad |h(\xi)-h(\eta)|\leq2\pi b\|u\|_2|\xi-\eta|$$ for all $\xi,\eta\in\mathbf R^m$. In particular $h$ is continuous, and bounded L2 families supported almost everywhere in this same $K$ have a common bound and a common Lipschitz constant for their Fourier integrals.

proof.text: Apply compact-continuous integrability to $1$ and $|x|^2$ on $K$, embedded as complex-valued functions. Thus $v=\int_K1$ and $b^2=\int_K|x|^2$ are finite. Set $a=1_K$ and $c=1_K|u|$, real measurable functions on $\mathbf R^m$. Their squared integrals are $v$ and at most $\|u\|_2^2$, so scalar $L^2$ Cauchy–Schwarz gives $\int_K|u|=\int|ac|\leq\sqrt v\|u\|_2$. Since $u=0$ almost everywhere off $K$, its norm has the same integral as $c$; consequently $u\in L^1$. No pointwise support hypothesis is used.

source.place: §2, Lemma 2.7 proof, pp.5–6, compact-support Fourier equicontinuity; agent specialization for t=1.

proof.text: The phase identities give $|e^{-2\pi i x\cdot\xi}|=1$. Its dependence on $x$ is continuous: factoring the difference of phases and using the scalar phase estimate bounds it by $2\pi|\xi||x-y|$. Here $|a\cdot b|\leq|a||b|$ follows directly, when $b\ne0$, from $0\leq|a-((a\cdot b)/|b|^2)b|^2=|a|^2-(a\cdot b)^2/|b|^2$; $b=0$ is immediate. Thus the product with measurable $u$ is strongly measurable, since $\mathbf C$ is separable. Its norm is $|u|$. The cited majorant theorem gives absolute convergence and $|h(\xi)|\leq\int|u|\leq\sqrt v\|u\|_2$.

source.place: §2, Lemma 2.7 proof, pp.5–6, compact-support Fourier equicontinuity; agent specialization for t=1.

proof.text: First apply scalar $L^2$ Cauchy–Schwarz to the real functions $1_K|x|$ and $1_K|u|$, whose squared integrals are $b^2$ and at most $\|u\|_2^2$. It gives integrability of their product and $\int_K|x||u|\leq b\|u\|_2$. For $A=-2\pi x\cdot\xi$ and $B=-2\pi x\cdot\eta$, the phase identities yield $e^{iA}-e^{iB}=e^{iB}(e^{i(A-B)}-1)$, hence $|e^{iA}-e^{iB}|\leq|A-B|\leq2\pi|x||\xi-\eta|$, by the dot-product calculation in step 2. Both Fourier integrands are integrable by step 2. Integral subtraction therefore identifies $h(\xi)-h(\eta)$ with the integral of their difference. That difference has integrable norm majorant $2\pi|\xi-\eta|1_K|x||u|$ almost everywhere. The majorant estimate now gives $|h(\xi)-h(\eta)|\leq2\pi|\xi-\eta|\int_K|x||u|\leq2\pi b\|u\|_2|\xi-\eta|$.

source.place: §2, Lemma 2.7 proof, pp.5–6, compact-support Fourier equicontinuity; agent specialization for t=1.

proof.text: The displayed global Lipschitz estimate implies continuity of h. If a family has a common L² bound and all members vanish almost everywhere off the same K, the two displayed constants depend only on that bound, v and b, so they are common to the whole family.

source.place: §2, Lemma 2.7 proof, pp.5–6, compact-support Fourier equicontinuity; agent specialization for t=1.

lean.statement: theorem fixed_support_fourier_bounds_lipschitz (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))) (hK : IsCompact K) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → ℂ) (hu : MemLp u 2 volume) (hsupport : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ K → u x = 0) : volume K ≠ ⊤ ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ↦ ‖x‖ ^ 2) K volume ∧ Integrable u volume ∧ (∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ↦ Complex.exp ((↑(-2 * Real.pi * ⟪x, ξ⟫) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * u x) volume) ∧ (∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖𝓕 u ξ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (volume K).toReal * Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖u x‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ ξ η : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), ‖𝓕 u ξ - 𝓕 u η‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (∫ x in K, ‖x‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) * ‖ξ - η‖) ∧ Continuous (𝓕 u) ∧ (∀ (I : Type w) (f : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → ℂ) (M : NNReal), (∀ i : I, MemLp (f i) 2 volume) → (∀ i : I, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ K → f i x = 0) → (∀ i : I, Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖f i x‖ ^ 2) ≤ M) → (∀ (i : I) (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖𝓕 (f i) ξ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (volume K).toReal * M) ∧ (∀ (i : I) (ξ η : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ‖𝓕 (f i) ξ - 𝓕 (f i) η‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (∫ x in K, ‖x‖ ^ 2) * M * ‖ξ - η‖))
